summary: Round 13 recheck (26 Sep 22:55-23:40Z). Three closed ideas were re-read against the new facts and two were measured on CPU. Nothing is submitted, pushed or committed, and finals #37 + #38 and L9 are unchanged. (A) I-108 B19 + the node-count story of the model swaps: the 11 Sep claim 'FT detectors lose through +3-4% nodes' holds for 1 of 3 LB swaps only. exp32 (exp23 FT secondary) had +0.62% nodes over its own base exp30 and still lost -0.007. The soup had fewer nodes than exp33 and scored lower. So the exp72 plan's harm proxy (dummy nodes within [-2%,+1%]; 'do not wait for G2') would have PASSED the exact exp23 failure. Make G2 (the 44b6-only FT on the 39 held-out 6bba lab clips) blocking, or state that the probe is unguarded. B19 itself stays closed: the x138 cell-1 guard crashes on DET_THRESHOLD != 0.965. (B) I-202/I-231 (K2-stack lab, dropped at VOI ~2e-5) REVIVED AND RUN: the exp64 bed (x138 + lowrefine + dump-only insertion, 71 44b6 clips) already existed. Deltas vs ins35 (K2-like): lp30 +0.00051 (66/5 clips; lowrefine costs 4 TP edges that the no-lowrefine exp60 bed never showed); fm45 +0.00035 (1 FP fork); lp30+fm45 +0.00086; dc0.30 +0.00336 (9 FP forks removed in 9 clips, 0 TP; all division term). This also covers the 17 clips where the exp60 control bed read -0.0006, the 'embryo-negative' reason K3b failed T9. That reason does not reproduce in K2 context, but 44b6 is in-sample for DeepCenter. (C) I-075 6bba extension (moot since K3b failed) regains decision value as a lazily triggered veto, because L9 can now make dc0.30 a final on a public display alone. Pre-register it before exp70d/e score (~06:30Z). Value is modest (~1-3 ranks expected). Scripts and outputs: scratchpad r13rc/.

findings.what:
I-108 B19 (det-threshold re-calibration so a fine-tuned detector matches pilkwang's node count) and the node-count explanation of our model-swap losses (A24/A26/A27; FACTS F-TRN-41 'exp23 fine-tuned secondary -0.007 (+3.9% nodes)').

OLD VERDICT. The 11 Sep re-exam (CONTEXT l.305-313) said: 'all three put 3-4% MORE nodes through det 0.965 ... surplus nodes eat the bonus'. B19 was DROPPED because its gate failed (exp33 0.944 < 0.946) and because A29 (det 0.99 = 0.942) showed that a higher threshold loses.

WHAT CHANGED. The exp71/exp72 distilled-secondary line is live: it needs the user's R9 yes, expected ~07:30-09:00Z. Its harm gates rest on this same story:
- r_retrain RT-3: 'a detection-count ratio is the harm proxy (exp23's losing swap had +3.9% nodes)'.
- v_retrain: G1 [0.97, 1.04] is rejected because it 'would pass the exact failure of exp23'; the dummy gate is tightened to [-2%, +1%]; 'submit as soon as the dummy passes; do NOT wait for G2'.

RE-DERIVED from the logged dummy counts (CONTEXT l.307: exp29 125,305 / exp30 129,340 / exp32 130,146 nodes). The node multiplier is dS ~ -0.1*J*dN/N_est, with N_pred/N_est between 0.64 (hold12) and ~1.
- exp30 (FT primary): +3.2% predicts -0.0018..-0.0029. Observed -0.003. This matches.
- exp32 vs its own base exp30 (the SECONDARY swap alone): +0.62% predicts -0.0004..-0.0006. Observed -0.007. Nodes explain <= ~1/10 of the loss.
- Soup: about half the primary shift predicts -0.0009..-0.0014. Observed -0.004. It also scored BELOW exp33, which had more nodes.
The '+3.9%' in F-TRN-41 and RT-3 is measured against exp29 and includes the primary's +3.2%.

NEW VERDICT. B19 STAYS CLOSED, with a corrected reason:
(1) Node count is not the main loss channel of secondary swaps.
(2) x138 cell 1 raises 'Configuration drift detected' when BIOHUB_DET_THRESHOLD != 0.965 (FACTS F-MOD-26 / I-309), so a threshold rescue is not buildable with --set.
(3) x138 z-aligns the secondary detection logits per frame to the primary (mean/std, ratio clamp 0.5-2), which damps calibration shifts even more.
PLAN ISSUE: exp72's node-count gate is necessary but NOT sufficient. The exp23 swap would have passed [-2%, +1%] (+0.62%) and still lost 0.007 on the LB.

The harm channel seen in the exp60 control bed on 44b6 is edge loss when fork removal leaves short orphan tracks (adj edge -0.0012, 0 TP forks lost). That channel does not depend on division density. NEW VERDICT: REVIVED as a conditional, pre-registered veto. Its value is modest, because both available beds now read dc0.30 >= 0: 6bba control +0.0010 and 44b6 K2 +0.0034 (see R13-RC-B).

Overall: P(V* contains dc0.30) ~0.15-0.25 and P(dc0.30 hurts private) ~0.3, so the expected gain is ~1-3 ranks, at ~6 GPU-h that compete with exp71.
